messages.subject: Measurement invariance with WLSMV/binary data
parts:
Hello all, 

we try to test measurement invariance for the following model:

drei.dim.gffmethod <- ' ER =~
cER058c + cER097a + cER040a + cER040b +
cER040c + cER040d + cER012a + cER012b +
cER085d + cER119a + cER119b + cER105a +
cER115a
EL =~
cEL114d + cEL114e + cEL169b + cEL169e +
cEL151b + cEL160f + cEL108c + cEL108e 
CV =~ 
cSV02A + cSV02C + cSV03C + cSV03D + cSV03G +
cSV03H + cSV04D + cSV04F + cSV04J +
cSV04L + cSV04M + cSV05C + cSV05D
GFM =~
NA*gff01k + gff03k + gff04k + gff05k + 1*gff06k + gff07k + 
gff09k + gff11k 
gff01k ~~ gff11k 
'

fit.3dim.konf <- cfa(drei.dim.gffmethod,
                     data=dat,
                     estimator="WLSMV",
                     meanstructure=T,
                     group="geschlecht")

Every single measurement model is fine. However, the combination of the first three with the last one results in the following error message:

Fehler in nlminb(start = start.x, objective = minimize.this.function, gradient = GRADIENT,  : 
  NA/NaN gradient evaluation

We have no clue why the combination of these models leads to this error. Any suggestions are very appreciated.
Thanks! Rasmus & Kai
